title: Run the Papyrus pipeline bootstrap and CDK bootstrap
description: Run the Papyrus pipeline bootstrap and CDK bootstrap

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-11-11: CDK bootstrap done in us-east-1 (CDKToolkit CREATE_COMPLETE). The Papyrus pipeline bootstrap (infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh) was NOT run, on purpose: by default it trusts the Papyrus repository and would overwrite that repository's AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable with this account, redirecting Papyrus's own releases; its stacks also name another organisation's domain. It needs the Papyrus change in PPY-1a6aa6 before it fits a second organisation. The account has no GitHub OIDC provider yet; the deploy role for Humorus will need one.
